Name: The Amazing Apiary Mail
Author: januarywren
Description:
[center]Hi everyone! If you love bees and want to enhance your #cottagecore aesthetic, this mod is for you. -:) You'll receive a weekly letter from the 'Amazing Apiary' magazine that highlights incredible facts about bees... + a small gift![/center]
[quote][i]"Dear [Player],

Thank you for subscribing to the 'Amazing Apiary' magazine! The Amazing Apiary is dedicated to illuminating the secret life of bees, and those who care for them.

A new issue will arrive every week with true and fascinating bee facts (and a small gift for you!). Your first issue will arrive soon - so keep an eye out!

From, The Amazing Apiary[/i][/quote]
[center][color=#b4a7d6]Mod Content[/color]

Facts range from the remarkable (the Megachile pluto, or 'Flying Bulldog,' is the world's largest bee, averaging 2.5in (6 cm) in wingspan!) to the unusual (Agnes Powell, the founder of the Girl Scouts, adored bees so much that she kept a colony in her house!) to the downright terrifying (varroa mites are to honeybees what bedbugs are to humans!). 

Letters are scheduled to arrive on the [color=#ea9999]6th, 12th, 18th, and 24th[/color]! 

For *4+ in-game years* the letters will be unique (regardless of when the mod is downloaded - i.e., if you install the mod in your 5th in-game year, then you'll receive unique letters until your 9th in-game year.). 

[color=#ea9999]Required Mods[/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod﻿[/url]﻿

[color=#d5a6bd]Mod Compatibility[/color]

This mod shouldn't clash with other mods however Mail Framework Mod will [b]*not*[/b] work with FeTK and Tool-Upgrade Delivery Service. 

[color=#ea9999]Credit
[/color]
I couldn't have made this mod without the help of Emhx, who created a new template for the mod, and extensively tested it. (Plus Emhx has a keen eye for catching spelling and grammar mistakes!) 

[color=#b4a7d6]About Me[/color]

Hello! My name is January. I've loved writing ever since I can remember, as well as video games and modding. Modders, you guys are the best! I couldn't play Stardew Valley or Skyrim without you. Same to you, indie devs! 

If you are looking for a writer/editor for your modding projects, please send me a message! ??

[url=https://januarywren.carrd.co/]My Portfolio[/url]﻿ | [url=https://januarywren.tumblr.com/]My Tumblr [/url][/center]
